title: 香港環球貿易廣場~International Commerce Centre
focus: 在填海地盤與颱風環境中，以核心筒、八根巨柱、四道外伸臂與摩擦型壁樁支撐 484 m 塔樓~Supporting a 484 m tower on reclaimed land in a typhoon climate with a core, eight mega-columns, four outrigger levels and friction barrettes
summary: 環球貿易廣場高 484 m、地上 108 層（樓層編號至 118），坐落在西九龍填海區的九龍站上方。結構以鋼筋混凝土核心筒、八根巨柱與四道外伸臂組成，最低一道為預力混凝土外伸臂，其餘三道為鋼構；凹角平面與上部 1° 內傾減弱颱風下的渦流激振，巨柱在底部外撇約 3°。岩盤深約 70 至 130 m 且起伏如懸崖，因此改用平均深約 70 m 的灌漿摩擦型壁樁。本課從颱風風荷載、外伸臂、預力與外撇巨柱，到壁樁施工、高空風速管控、風洞縮尺、載重試驗、海埔地耐久與颱風後交接。~The International Commerce Centre is 484 m tall with 108 storeys above ground (numbered to 118), standing over Kowloon Station on West Kowloon reclamation. Its structure combines a reinforced-concrete core, eight mega-columns and four outrigger levels, the lowest in prestressed concrete and the other three in steel; notched corners and a 1° inward lean of the upper façades weaken typhoon vortex excitation, and the mega-columns splay outward about 3° at the base. With bedrock about 70 to 130 m down in a cliff-like profile, shaft-grouted friction barrettes averaging about 70 m deep were used. The course runs from typhoon wind, outriggers, prestress and splayed columns to barrette construction, wind control at height, wind-tunnel scaling, load testing, durability on reclaimed land and post-typhoon handover.

units.anchor: 凹角方形平面~Notched square plan
units.title: 颱風風荷載與凹角平面~Typhoon wind and the notched plan
units.mechanism: 香港位於颱風路徑上，超高層的設計風速與紊流由颱風氣候控制，橫風向的渦流激振往往比順風向更影響舒適度。環球貿易廣場採方形平面並在四角做凹角，凹角向上逐漸加寬，上部三分之一的主立面再向內傾斜 1°；公開資料指出初步風洞研究顯示此形狀的風反應接近圓形斷面。凹角讓角隅分離流提早重新附著或被打散，降低橫風向升力的強度與規律性，同時減少整體阻力係數。~Hong Kong lies on typhoon tracks, so design wind speed and turbulence for supertall towers are governed by typhoon climate, and across-wind vortex excitation often matters more for comfort than along-wind response. The tower has a square plan with notched corners that widen toward the top, and the main façades of the upper third lean inward by 1°; public sources report that preliminary wind-tunnel studies found the shape's wind response close to that of a circle. The notches make corner separation reattach earlier or break up, reducing the strength and regularity of across-wind lift and lowering the overall drag coefficient.
units.model: 基座力矩 M = q·C_f·B·H²/2。取 q = 2.2 kPa、B = 60 m、H = 484 m：方角 C_f = 2.0 時 M ≈ 3.09×10⁷ kN·m；凹角使 C_f 降為 1.5 時 M ≈ 2.32×10⁷ kN·m，約減少 25%。數值為教學假設，未計高度變化與動力放大。~Base moment M = q·C_f·B·H²/2. With q = 2.2 kPa, B = 60 m and H = 484 m, sharp corners with C_f = 2.0 give M ≈ 3.09×10⁷ kN·m, while notched corners lowering C_f to 1.5 give M ≈ 2.32×10⁷ kN·m, about 25% less. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring height variation and dynamic amplification.
units.verify: 比較方角、凹角與不同凹角尺寸的剛性模型風洞試驗結果，檢查各風向的平均與擾動力矩、橫風向力頻譜峰值與頂部加速度；並確認風洞採用的颱風風速剖面與紊流強度符合香港風力規範的要求或經認可的颱風氣候研究。~Compare rigid-model wind-tunnel results for sharp corners, notched corners and several notch sizes, checking mean and fluctuating moments by direction, the peak of the across-wind force spectrum and top acceleration; confirm that the typhoon wind profile and turbulence used match the Hong Kong wind code or an accepted typhoon-climate study.
units.failure: 若只依規範靜力公式設計而未做風洞，可能忽略特定颱風風向的橫風向共振，完工後在八號以上颱風信號時頂層擺動明顯；凹角若在設計後期被縮小，原有風洞結論就不再適用。~Designing only with code static formulas and no wind tunnel can miss across-wind resonance for particular typhoon directions, leading to noticeable top-floor motion under signal No. 8 or higher; if the notches are reduced late in design, the original wind-tunnel conclusions no longer apply.
units.misconception: 凹角只是建築語彙，與颱風下的結構反應無關。~Notched corners are an architectural motif with no bearing on typhoon response.
units.practice: 建築外形在風洞試驗後若有任何角隅、退縮或頂部造型變更，都要由風工程顧問書面評估是否需要重做試驗，並把結論附入設計基準報告。~After the wind-tunnel test, any change to corners, setbacks or crown geometry requires a written assessment by the wind consultant on whether retesting is needed, attached to the design basis report.

units.anchor: 八根巨柱與四道外伸臂~Eight mega-columns and four outrigger levels
units.title: 巨柱—外伸臂系統的轉動勁度~Rotational stiffness of the mega-column–outrigger system
units.mechanism: 公開資料指出 Leslie E. Robertson 在概念階段提出以八根巨柱圍成「方形甜甜圈」平面，鋼筋混凝土核心筒居中，外伸臂桁架在四個樓層把核心筒與巨柱相連。核心筒在側力下彎曲轉動時，外伸臂迫使巨柱一側伸長、一側縮短，巨柱的軸向勁度乘上力臂平方，就成為抵抗核心轉動的彈簧；八根巨柱位於最外圍，力臂最大，因此用相對少的材料取得高轉動勁度，同時讓周邊樓層保有開闊的視野與跨度。~Public sources state that Leslie E. Robertson proposed at concept stage a square-donut plan of eight mega-columns with the reinforced-concrete core at its centre, connected by outrigger trusses at four levels. When the core bends and rotates under lateral load, the outriggers stretch columns on one side and shorten those on the other; the columns' axial stiffness multiplied by the square of the lever arm becomes a spring resisting core rotation. Because the eight mega-columns sit at the outer edge, their lever arm is largest, giving high rotational stiffness for relatively little material while keeping perimeter floors open with long spans.
units.model: 巨柱對外伸臂的轉動勁度 K_θ = 2(EA/L)(d/2)²。取巨柱 A = 8 m²、E = 36 GPa、外伸臂以下柱長 L = 200 m、兩側柱距 d = 50 m：EA/L = 1.44×10⁶ kN/m，K_θ = 2×1.44×10⁶×25² = 1.8×10⁹ kN·m/rad；核心筒 EI/L 以 I = 3,000 m⁴ 計為 5.4×10⁸ kN·m/rad，巨柱提供約 3.3 倍的轉動約束。數值為教學假設。~The rotational stiffness the columns give an outrigger is K_θ = 2(EA/L)(d/2)². With A = 8 m², E = 36 GPa, a column length below the outrigger L = 200 m and a spacing d = 50 m, EA/L = 1.44×10⁶ kN/m and K_θ = 2×1.44×10⁶×25² = 1.8×10⁹ kN·m/rad; the core's EI/L with I = 3,000 m⁴ is 5.4×10⁸ kN·m/rad, so the columns supply about 3.3 times the rotational restraint. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在分析模型中分別計算有無各道外伸臂時的頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒彎矩，確認四道外伸臂的位置效益；並以巨柱實際軸向勁度（含潛變與開裂後的有效值）做敏感度分析。~In the analysis model compute top drift, inter-storey drift and core moment with and without each outrigger level to confirm the benefit of each location, and run sensitivity studies with realistic mega-column axial stiffness including creep and effective cracked values.
units.failure: 若巨柱有效軸向勁度因潛變或開裂而低於假設，外伸臂的效果打折，頂部變位與加速度上升；外伸臂與巨柱接頭若未設計長期差異縮短造成的附加力，可能在多年後開裂。~If mega-column effective axial stiffness falls below the assumption because of creep or cracking, outrigger effectiveness drops and top drift and acceleration rise; joints between outriggers and mega-columns not designed for long-term differential-shortening forces may crack years later.
units.misconception: 外伸臂的效果主要來自外伸臂桁架本身的強度。~Outrigger effectiveness comes mainly from the strength of the outrigger truss itself.
units.practice: 外伸臂樓層應與避難層和機電層整合，並在設計文件中列出每道外伸臂的勁度假設、巨柱有效勁度與長期附加力，作為施工鎖定時機與日後監測的依據。~Integrate outrigger levels with refuge and plant floors, and record for each outrigger the stiffness assumption, effective mega-column stiffness and long-term added forces as the basis for locking time and later monitoring.

units.anchor: 預力混凝土外伸臂~Prestressed concrete outrigger
units.title: 最低一道預力混凝土外伸臂~The lowest outrigger in prestressed concrete
units.mechanism: 公開資料指出四道外伸臂中最低的一道採預力混凝土，其餘三道為鋼構。低樓層的外伸臂承受的力最大，若以鋼筋混凝土承受反覆拉力，會開裂並降低勁度；施加預力讓構件在常時與設計風荷載下保持受壓或拉應力很小，裂縫受到控制，勁度較穩定，也與周邊混凝土核心牆與巨柱的材料行為較一致。代價是預力損失、錨定區局部應力與施工順序都需要仔細規劃。~Public sources state that the lowest of the four outriggers is prestressed concrete while the other three are steel. The lowest outrigger carries the largest forces; reinforced concrete under reversing tension would crack and lose stiffness, whereas prestress keeps the member in compression or low tension under service and design wind loads, controlling cracks, stabilising stiffness and matching the behaviour of the surrounding concrete core and columns. The price is careful planning of prestress losses, local stresses in anchorage zones and construction sequence.
units.model: 外伸臂拉桿在設計風荷載下拉力 T = 30 MN，施加有效預力 P = 36 MN 後淨壓力 P − T = 6 MN；斷面 8 m² 時剩餘壓應力 6/8 = 0.75 MPa，預力本身平均壓應力 36/8 = 4.5 MPa。若長期預力損失 15%，P_eff = 30.6 MN，淨壓力只剩 0.6 MN。數值為教學假設。~An outrigger tie carrying T = 30 MN under design wind with an effective prestress P = 36 MN keeps a net compression of P − T = 6 MN; over an 8 m² section the residual compression is 6/8 = 0.75 MPa, and the prestress alone averages 36/8 = 4.5 MPa. A 15% long-term loss leaves P_eff = 30.6 MN and a net compression of only 0.6 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 預力施拉時同時記錄千斤頂壓力與鋼腱伸長量，兩者換算的力差應在規定允差內（例如 ±5%）；錨定區依設計配置螺旋筋與格網筋並在澆置前檢查；之後以長期監測或試驗估算預力損失，與設計假設比較。~During stressing record jack pressure and tendon elongation together, requiring the forces derived from each to agree within a specified tolerance such as ±5%; check spiral and grid reinforcement in anchorage zones before casting, and later estimate prestress losses from long-term monitoring or tests for comparison with the design assumption.
units.failure: 若預力損失被低估，外伸臂在颱風荷載下出現反覆張開的裂縫，勁度降低並讓鋼腱與錨具暴露於濕氣；錨定區配筋不足則在施拉時就可能爆裂。~Underestimated losses let the outrigger crack open repeatedly under typhoon loads, reducing stiffness and exposing tendons and anchors to moisture; insufficient anchorage-zone reinforcement can burst during stressing.
units.misconception: 預力只是用來增加構件的強度。~Prestress is only used to increase member strength.
units.practice: 預力施拉屬高風險作業，須由合格的專業施工單位依核准的施拉程序與順序進行，施拉紀錄由結構工程師審核後才能灌漿或封錨，並規定人員不得站在千斤頂軸線後方。~Stressing is a high-risk operation to be done by a qualified specialist under an approved procedure and sequence; stressing records must be reviewed by the structural engineer before grouting or capping, and nobody may stand behind the jack axis.

units.anchor: 底部外撇 3° 巨柱~Mega-columns splayed 3° at the base
units.title: 外撇巨柱的水平分力與繫梁~Horizontal thrust of splayed columns and ties
units.mechanism: 公開資料指出八根巨柱在底部向外撇約 3°，加寬基座以降低傾覆效應，並為飯店與展覽空間提供較長的淨跨。柱在轉折點改變方向時，軸壓力的方向改變會產生一個水平分力：在轉折樓層，柱被推向內側，需由樓板以壓力承接；在柱腳，柱把基礎往外推，需由基礎、地下室樓板或繫梁以拉力平衡。這些水平力隨柱軸力成正比，因此最大的巨柱在最低轉折處需要最強的水平傳力路徑。~Public sources state that the eight mega-columns splay outward about 3° at the base, widening the footprint to reduce overturning and giving longer clear spans for hotel and exhibition spaces. Where a column changes direction, the redirected axial compression produces a horizontal component: at the kink floor the column is pushed inward and the floor must take it in compression, while at the column foot the column pushes the foundation outward, which foundations, basement slabs or ties must balance in tension. These horizontal forces are proportional to column axial load, so the largest columns at the lowest kink need the strongest horizontal load path.
units.model: 水平分力 H = P·tanθ。巨柱軸力 P = 250 MN、θ = 3°（tan 3° ≈ 0.0524）：H ≈ 13.1 MN。轉折樓板需以壓力承接約 13.1 MN，柱腳另有同量的外推力由繫梁或地下室樓板受拉平衡；若外撇角加倍為 6°，H ≈ 26.3 MN。數值為教學假設。~The horizontal component is H = P·tanθ. For P = 250 MN and θ = 3° (tan 3° ≈ 0.0524), H ≈ 13.1 MN. The kink floor must carry about 13.1 MN in compression, and an equal outward thrust at the column foot must be balanced in tension by ties or basement slabs; doubling the splay to 6° gives H ≈ 26.3 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在模型中追蹤每根巨柱在轉折處的水平分力，檢查樓板隔板與繫梁的應力、開口削弱與續接位置；施工時量測巨柱轉折點的座標與傾角，確認符合圖說允差，並在繫梁施作完成前限制上部荷載。~Track the horizontal component at each mega-column kink in the model, checking diaphragm and tie stresses, weakening by openings and splice locations; during construction survey kink coordinates and inclination against tolerances and limit load above until the ties are complete.
units.failure: 若轉折樓板有大型開口（例如中庭或機電豎井）而未補強，水平分力找不到連續路徑，樓板邊緣開裂；繫梁或地下室樓板受拉能力不足，柱腳可能向外滑移，造成上部結構傾斜。~If the kink floor has large unstrengthened openings such as atria or shafts, the horizontal thrust has no continuous path and slab edges crack; ties or basement slabs short of tensile capacity can let column feet slide outward and tilt the structure above.
units.misconception: 傾斜柱只承受軸向力，不會對樓板產生額外負擔。~Inclined columns carry only axial force and impose nothing extra on the floors.
units.practice: 斜柱與轉折點的樓板應在圖上標示為「隔板傳力區」，限制日後開孔，並在施工順序中規定繫梁與樓板必須在上部荷載加到一定比例前完成。~Mark floors at inclined columns and kinks as diaphragm transfer zones on the drawings, restricting later openings, and require in the construction sequence that ties and slabs be complete before a set proportion of the load above is applied.

units.anchor: 灌漿摩擦型壁樁~Shaft-grouted friction barrettes
units.title: 填海地盤上的壁樁基礎~Barrette foundations on reclaimed land
units.mechanism: 基地位於填海區，岩盤深約 70 至 130 m 且起伏如懸崖，傳統鑽掘樁與打入式 H 型鋼樁都不適用，因此採用矩形鋼筋混凝土的摩擦型壁樁（barrette），平均深度約 70 m，以四個側面與周圍土層的摩擦力傳遞荷載；公開資料指出其還做了樁身灌漿。壁樁以抓斗在穩定液保護下開挖成槽，放入鋼筋籠後以特密管澆置；樁身灌漿是在混凝土硬化後經預埋管對樁側土層加壓灌漿，修補泥膜並提高側摩擦。~The site is reclaimed land over a cliff-like rock surface about 70 to 130 m deep, ruling out conventional bored piles and driven H-piles, so rectangular reinforced-concrete friction piles called barrettes were used, averaging about 70 m deep and transferring load by friction on their four faces; public sources note they were shaft-grouted. Barrettes are excavated as slots by grab under support fluid, then a reinforcement cage is lowered and concrete placed by tremie; shaft grouting pumps grout under pressure through pre-installed pipes into the surrounding soil after the concrete hardens, repairing the filter cake and increasing side friction.
units.model: 側摩擦承載 Q_s = 周長×L×f_s。壁樁 2.8 m×1.5 m 周長 8.6 m、L = 70 m：未灌漿 f_s = 100 kPa 時 Q_s = 8.6×70×100 = 60,200 kN；灌漿使 f_s 提高到 150 kPa 時 Q_s = 90,300 kN，增加 50%。數值為教學假設。~Side-friction capacity is Q_s = perimeter×L×f_s. A 2.8 m×1.5 m barrette has an 8.6 m perimeter; with L = 70 m and ungrouted f_s = 100 kPa, Q_s = 8.6×70×100 = 60,200 kN; shaft grouting that raises f_s to 150 kPa gives Q_s = 90,300 kN, 50% more. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 開挖時以超音波槽壁量測儀檢查槽體垂直度與尺寸，穩定液的密度、黏度與含砂率每班抽驗；澆置後以聲波透測（CSL）檢查樁身完整性，灌漿則記錄每個閥口的壓力與灌入量，與預定的停止條件比較。~During excavation check slot verticality and dimensions with an ultrasonic trench profiler and test support-fluid density, viscosity and sand content every shift; after concreting verify integrity by cross-hole sonic logging, and for grouting record pressure and volume at each valve against the predefined stop criteria.
units.failure: 穩定液含砂率過高或底部沉渣未清，會在樁側形成厚泥膜或在底部留下軟弱層，使摩擦與端承不足而產生過大沉陷；灌漿壓力控制不當則可能使地表隆起或灌漿流失到鄰近管線。~Support fluid with too much sand or uncleaned base sediment leaves a thick filter cake on the faces or a soft layer at the toe, so friction and end bearing fall short and settlement becomes excessive; poorly controlled grout pressure can heave the ground or lose grout into nearby utilities.
units.misconception: 岩盤很深時就只能用很長的端承樁，摩擦樁不可靠。~Where bedrock is deep, only very long end-bearing piles work; friction piles are unreliable.
units.practice: 壁樁施工應有逐樁的開挖、穩定液、鋼筋籠與澆置紀錄，灌漿作業列為停留點並由大地工程師核可停止條件；鄰近九龍站與地下管線的區段須另訂變位監測與警戒值。~Keep pile-by-pile records of excavation, support fluid, cage and concreting, make grouting a hold point with stop criteria approved by the geotechnical engineer, and set separate movement monitoring and alert levels for sections next to Kowloon Station and buried utilities.

units.anchor: 颱風季高空風速管控~High-level wind control in typhoon season
units.title: 颱風季施工與高空風速管控~Typhoon-season construction and wind control at height
units.mechanism: 超高層施工期長，必然跨越多個颱風季。塔吊、爬模、外架與尚未封閉的樓層都對風敏感：風速隨高度增加，地面風速計的讀值會低估施工面所受的風；颱風來臨前必須讓塔吊自由迴轉、收妥爬模與吊籠、固定鬆散材料並撤離高空人員。外伸臂與鋼構尚未鎖定時，結構的側向勁度與完工狀態不同，也需要檢核施工階段在颱風下的穩定與變位。~A supertall project spans several typhoon seasons. Tower cranes, climbing forms, scaffolds and unenclosed floors are all wind-sensitive: wind speed increases with height, so a ground anemometer underestimates wind at the working face, and before a typhoon cranes must be left free to slew, climbing forms and hoists secured, loose material tied down and workers withdrawn from height. With outriggers and steel not yet locked, lateral stiffness differs from the completed state, so construction-stage stability and drift under typhoon wind must also be checked.
units.model: 冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α，海面與填海區取 α = 0.16：400 m 處 V = V₁₀×40^0.16 ≈ 1.80V₁₀。地面 10 m 讀到 V₁₀ = 10 m/s 時，施工面約 18.0 m/s；V₁₀ = 12 m/s 時約 21.7 m/s，已超過常見塔吊吊裝限值 20 m/s。數值為教學假設。~With the power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and α = 0.16 for sea and reclaimed exposure, at 400 m V = V₁₀×40^0.16 ≈ 1.80V₁₀. A ground reading of V₁₀ = 10 m/s means about 18.0 m/s at the working face, and V₁₀ = 12 m/s about 21.7 m/s, beyond a common crane lifting limit of 20 m/s. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在塔吊頂與施工面設置風速計，以施工面實測值而非地面值決定是否停止吊裝；颱風前依檢查表確認塔吊迴轉釋放、爬模錨定與材料綁紮，並由結構工程師確認未完成結構在颱風風速下的變位與構件應力。~Install anemometers on crane tops and at the working face and use those readings, not ground values, to stop lifting; before a typhoon confirm crane slewing release, climbing-form anchorage and material lashing against a checklist, and have the structural engineer confirm drift and member stresses of the incomplete structure at typhoon wind speed.
units.failure: 以地面風速判斷而在高空繼續吊裝，吊物擺動與塔吊過載的風險大增；颱風前未固定的模板或材料被吹落，對鄰近道路、車站與人員造成嚴重危害。~Continuing lifts at height based on ground wind readings greatly raises the risk of swinging loads and crane overload; formwork or material left unsecured before a typhoon can be blown off and endanger nearby roads, the station and people.
units.misconception: 地面風速不大時，高空施工面的風也一樣小。~If ground-level wind is light, wind at the high working face is light too.
units.practice: 施工計畫應包含颱風應變程序：依天文台信號分級的停工、固定與撤離步驟、負責人與檢查表，並在每次颱風後完成塔吊、爬模與外架的檢查才能復工。~The construction plan must include a typhoon procedure with stop-work, securing and evacuation steps graded by the Observatory signal, named responsible persons and checklists, and work may resume only after cranes, climbing forms and scaffolds are inspected after each typhoon.

units.anchor: 風洞縮尺與時間比例~Wind-tunnel scale and time ratio
units.title: 風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算~Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests
units.mechanism: 風洞試驗把建築與周邊地形縮到數百分之一，並以較低的風速吹拂，因此量到的時間、頻率與壓力都必須依相似律換算回實尺度。長度比與風速比決定時間比，進而決定一段實尺度風暴對應的試驗取樣長度，以及建築模態頻率在模型上應落在的頻段。若時間比換算錯誤，風洞的尖峰值統計與加速度預測都會失真；對於像九龍站上方這種周邊有密集高樓與海面的場址，邊界層模擬同樣重要。~A wind-tunnel test shrinks the building and surroundings to a few hundredths of full size and blows slower wind over them, so measured times, frequencies and pressures must be converted back to full scale by similitude. The length and velocity scales set the time scale, which in turn sets how long a sample must be to represent a full-scale storm and where the building's modal frequencies fall on the model. A wrong time scale distorts peak statistics and acceleration predictions; for a site like the one above Kowloon Station, with dense towers on one side and open sea on another, boundary-layer simulation is equally important.
units.model: 時間比 λ_t = λ_L/λ_V。取長度比 1:500、風速比 1:3：λ_t = (1/500)/(1/3) = 1/166.7，實尺度 1 小時在試驗中只需 3,600/166.7 ≈ 21.6 s；頻率比為 166.7，實尺度 0.15 Hz 的模態在模型上對應約 25 Hz。數值為教學假設。~The time scale is λ_t = λ_L/λ_V. With a 1:500 length scale and a 1:3 velocity scale, λ_t = (1/500)/(1/3) = 1/166.7, so one full-scale hour needs only 3,600/166.7 ≈ 21.6 s in the tunnel; the frequency scale is 166.7, so a 0.15 Hz full-scale mode corresponds to about 25 Hz on the model. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 審查風洞報告時核對長度比、風速比與時間比的換算，確認取樣時間足以涵蓋多個實尺度小時並取得穩定的尖峰統計；以空場邊界層量測驗證風速剖面與紊流頻譜，並抽查一個風向的原始時間序列重新計算尖峰值。~When reviewing the wind-tunnel report, check the conversions between length, velocity and time scales, confirm sampling covers several full-scale hours for stable peak statistics, verify the wind profile and turbulence spectrum with empty-tunnel boundary-layer measurements, and recompute peaks from the raw time series for one direction.
units.failure: 若試驗取樣只對應實尺度十幾分鐘，尖峰值的統計不穩定，設計風壓可能被低估；若模型的天平或支架自身頻率落在換算後的建築頻段內，量到的力頻譜會被污染而誤判共振。~Sampling equivalent to only a few full-scale minutes gives unstable peak statistics and can underestimate design pressures; if the force balance or model mount has its own frequency within the scaled building band, the measured spectrum is contaminated and resonance misjudged.
units.misconception: 風洞模型只要外形縮尺正確，量到的數據就可以直接當作實尺度使用。~If the model shape is scaled correctly, the measured data can be used directly at full scale.
units.practice: 委託風洞試驗時，在合約中要求報告列出相似律參數、取樣長度、天平頻率、周邊模型範圍與原始資料格式，並保留原始時間序列供日後重新分析。~When commissioning wind-tunnel testing, require the report to list similitude parameters, sampling length, balance frequency, proximity-model extent and raw data format, and retain the raw time series for later reanalysis.

units.anchor: 壁樁載重試驗~Barrette load testing
units.title: 壁樁載重試驗與彈性縮短~Barrette load tests and elastic shortening
units.mechanism: 摩擦型壁樁的承載力取決於土層摩擦與施工品質，必須以現地載重試驗驗證，而不能只靠計算。試驗時樁頭沉陷包含樁身彈性縮短與樁底或樁側土層的位移，兩者需分開：在樁身不同深度埋設應變計或伸縮計，可以得到軸力沿深度的衰減，從而推算各土層的實際摩擦力，並檢驗灌漿是否提高了側摩擦。長達 70 m 的樁，樁身彈性縮短本身就可能達數十毫米。~The capacity of friction barrettes depends on soil friction and workmanship and must be proven by in-situ load tests rather than calculation alone. Head settlement in a test includes elastic shortening of the shaft and movement of soil along the sides or at the toe, and the two must be separated: strain gauges or extensometers at several depths give the decay of axial force with depth, from which the actual friction in each layer is back-calculated and the benefit of grouting verified. For a 70 m pile, elastic shortening of the shaft alone can reach tens of millimetres.
units.model: 樁身彈性縮短 δ = PL/(EA)（以樁頂軸力全長作用估算上限）。P = 60 MN、L = 70 m、E = 30 GPa、A = 2.8×1.5 = 4.2 m²：δ = 60,000×70/(30×10⁶×4.2) ≈ 0.033 m = 33 mm。若樁頂實測沉陷 40 mm，土層位移只約 7 mm；實際軸力沿深度遞減，真實縮短會小於 33 mm。數值為教學假設。~Elastic shortening of the shaft is δ = PL/(EA), an upper bound assuming the head load acts over the full length. With P = 60 MN, L = 70 m, E = 30 GPa and A = 2.8×1.5 = 4.2 m², δ = 60,000×70/(30×10⁶×4.2) ≈ 0.033 m = 33 mm. If the head settles 40 mm, soil movement is only about 7 mm; because axial force decays with depth, the true shortening is less than 33 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依核准的試驗計畫分級加載並維持荷載，記錄樁頭沉陷、各深度應變與時間；以試驗荷載（例如設計荷載的兩倍）下的沉陷與殘餘沉陷對照允收準則，並以應變計推算的側摩擦分布與設計假設比較，必要時修正其他壁樁的設計。~Load in stages and hold each stage under an approved test plan, recording head settlement, strain at each depth and time; compare settlement and residual settlement at the test load, for example twice the design load, with acceptance criteria, and compare the friction profile back-calculated from strain gauges with design assumptions, revising other barrettes if needed.
units.failure: 若只看樁頭沉陷而不扣除樁身縮短，可能誤判土層已大量滑移而過度保守，或反之把樁身品質問題（例如夾泥造成局部軟化）誤認為土層行為；反力系統不足則可能在試驗中失穩。~Reading only head settlement without subtracting shaft shortening can misjudge large soil slip and be over-conservative, or conversely mistake a shaft defect such as a soil inclusion for soil behaviour; an inadequate reaction system can become unstable during the test.
units.misconception: 樁頭沉陷全部來自樁底或樁側土壤的變形。~All head settlement in a pile test comes from soil deformation at the toe or sides.
units.practice: 載重試驗屬高能量作業，反力樑、錨樁或配重須經設計與檢查，試驗區設置警戒範圍；試驗結果由大地工程師出具報告並經主管機關接受後，工程樁才可據以施作或驗收。~A load test stores high energy: reaction beams, anchor piles or kentledge must be designed and inspected and an exclusion zone set; working piles may be installed or accepted on the basis of the results only after the geotechnical engineer's report is accepted by the authority.

units.anchor: 海埔地氯離子與耐久~Chlorides and durability on reclaimed land
units.title: 填海地下結構的氯離子侵蝕~Chloride attack on below-ground structure in reclamation
units.mechanism: 填海地盤的地下水含鹽，地下室外牆、筏基與壁樁長期接觸含氯離子的水；臨海環境的鹽霧也會影響低樓層外露混凝土。氯離子經混凝土孔隙擴散到鋼筋表面，濃度超過門檻後鈍化膜破壞，鋼筋開始腐蝕並膨脹使混凝土剝落。耐久設計以保護層厚度、低水膠比、摻爐石粉或飛灰降低擴散係數、裂縫寬度控制與防水層共同處理，並以設計年限推估需要的保護層。~Groundwater in reclaimed land is saline, so basement walls, the mat and barrettes are in long-term contact with chloride-bearing water, and sea spray affects exposed concrete at low levels. Chlorides diffuse through the pores to the reinforcement; once the concentration exceeds a threshold the passive film breaks down, the steel corrodes and expands, and the concrete spalls. Durability design combines cover depth, a low water–binder ratio, slag or fly ash to reduce the diffusion coefficient, crack-width control and waterproofing, using the design life to estimate the cover needed.
units.model: 以簡化擴散深度 x ≈ 2√(Dt) 估算氯離子前緣到達保護層的時間 t = x²/(4D)。保護層 50 mm：D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s 時 t = 0.05²/(4×10⁻¹²) ≈ 6.25×10⁸ s ≈ 19.8 年；摻爐石使 D = 5×10⁻¹³ m²/s 時 t ≈ 39.6 年，加倍。數值為教學假設，未計門檻濃度。~Using the simplified penetration depth x ≈ 2√(Dt), the time for the chloride front to reach the cover is t = x²/(4D). For 50 mm cover and D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s, t = 0.05²/(4×10⁻¹²) ≈ 6.25×10⁸ s ≈ 19.8 years; slag that lowers D to 5×10⁻¹³ m²/s gives t ≈ 39.6 years, twice as long. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring the threshold concentration.
units.verify: 配比階段以快速氯離子滲透或遷移試驗確認擴散性能；施工時以保護層測定儀抽查鋼筋保護層，防水層做接縫與破損檢查；營運後定期取芯量測氯離子剖面，推估到達鋼筋的剩餘時間。~At mix design, confirm diffusion performance with rapid chloride permeability or migration tests; during construction check cover with a covermeter and inspect waterproofing joints and damage; in service take cores periodically to measure chloride profiles and estimate the remaining time before reaching the steel.
units.failure: 保護層不足或裂縫過寬的部位會提早腐蝕，地下室牆面出現鏽水與剝落；在九龍站等設施上方，地下結構的修補空間與停用時間都極為受限，使問題處理成本倍增。~Areas with thin cover or wide cracks corrode early, showing rust staining and spalling on basement walls; above facilities such as Kowloon Station, repair access and shutdown windows are severely limited, multiplying the cost of remediation.
units.misconception: 地下結構不受日曬雨淋，所以不會有耐久問題。~Below-ground structure is sheltered from sun and rain, so it has no durability problems.
units.practice: 耐久設計報告應列出各部位暴露等級、保護層、配比限制與預期年限；竣工交接時附上保護層抽測紀錄與氯離子基準值，物業管理以此安排定期檢測。~The durability report should list exposure class, cover, mix limits and expected life for each element; handover should include cover survey records and chloride baselines so facility management can schedule periodic testing.

units.anchor: 颱風後檢查與回歸期~Post-typhoon inspection and return period
units.title: 颱風後檢查、回歸期與營運交接~Post-typhoon inspection, return periods and handover
units.mechanism: 設計風速以回歸期表示，但「50 年一遇」並不代表 50 年內只會遇到一次或一定不會遇到；在建築數十年的使用期內，遭遇接近設計等級颱風的機率相當高。因此營運階段需要有颱風前後的檢查制度：帷幕牆單元、屋頂設備、擋水與排水、外伸臂與巨柱接頭、監測資料都要在事件後檢視，並與基準比較。交接文件必須讓營運單位理解設計依據的回歸期、各系統的容許反應與事件後何時需要結構工程師介入。~Design wind speeds are expressed as return periods, but a 50-year event does not mean exactly one occurrence in 50 years, nor that it will not occur; over a building life of several decades, the chance of meeting a near-design typhoon is high. Operation therefore needs inspections before and after typhoons: curtain-wall units, roof equipment, flood barriers and drainage, outrigger and mega-column joints and monitoring data should be reviewed after each event and compared with baselines. Handover documents must let the operator understand the design return periods, the allowable response of each system and when a structural engineer must be called in after an event.
units.model: n 年內至少遭遇一次回歸期 T 事件的機率 P = 1 − (1 − 1/T)ⁿ。T = 50 年、n = 50 年：P = 1 − 0.98⁵⁰ ≈ 63.6%；T = 500 年：P ≈ 9.5%；T = 10 年：P ≈ 99.5%。數值為機率示範。~The probability of at least one event of return period T in n years is P = 1 − (1 − 1/T)ⁿ. For T = 50 years and n = 50 years, P = 1 − 0.98⁵⁰ ≈ 63.6%; for T = 500 years, P ≈ 9.5%; for T = 10 years, P ≈ 99.5%. Values are a probability illustration.
units.verify: 每次八號或以上颱風信號後，依檢查表巡查帷幕牆、屋頂與機電固定件，並調閱頂部加速度與風速紀錄，與設計預測和歷次事件比較；若任一反應超過預警值，由結構工程師進行詳細檢查並出具報告。~After each typhoon signal No. 8 or higher, inspect curtain wall, roof and services fixings against a checklist and review top acceleration and wind records against design predictions and previous events; if any response exceeds its alert level, a structural engineer carries out a detailed inspection and issues a report.
units.failure: 若營運單位誤以為設計颱風在使用期內不太可能發生而省略檢查，帷幕牆固定件或屋頂設備的累積損傷可能在下一次颱風中突然失效，造成墜落物危害。~An operator who believes the design typhoon is unlikely in the building's life and skips inspections can let accumulated damage to curtain-wall fixings or roof equipment fail suddenly in the next typhoon, creating falling-object hazards.
units.misconception: 50 年回歸期的颱風在 50 年內最多只會發生一次。~A 50-year-return typhoon can happen at most once in 50 years.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含設計回歸期與容許反應一覽、颱風前後檢查表、監測門檻與通報流程，並約定事件後結構工程師的到場時限與檢查範圍。~Handover should include a table of design return periods and allowable responses, pre- and post-typhoon checklists, monitoring thresholds and reporting procedures, and agree the response time and inspection scope for the structural engineer after events.

example: 設計練習：估算颱風下外伸臂傳給巨柱的軸力變化。以第 1 單元凹角平面的基座力矩 M = 2.2×1.5×60×484²/2 ≈ 2.32×10⁷ kN·m 為例，假設外伸臂把其中 40% 轉成巨柱的拉壓力偶，M_o ≈ 9.28×10⁶ kN·m。兩側巨柱群力臂 d = 50 m、每側 4 根巨柱，每根巨柱軸力變化 ΔP = M_o/(d×4) = 9.28×10⁶/(50×4) ≈ 46,400 kN。若每根巨柱的重力軸力為 250,000 kN，迎風側巨柱的壓力只減少約 18.6%，不會出現淨拉力；若外伸臂分擔提高到 60%，ΔP ≈ 69,600 kN（約 27.8%），仍維持受壓，但外伸臂與巨柱接頭的設計力同比例增加，長期差異縮短造成的附加力也必須一併檢核。數值為教學假設，不代表實際設計。~Design exercise: estimate the change in mega-column axial force delivered by outriggers under typhoon wind. Take the notched-plan base moment from unit 1, M = 2.2×1.5×60×484²/2 ≈ 2.32×10⁷ kN·m, and assume the outriggers convert 40% of it into a column couple, M_o ≈ 9.28×10⁶ kN·m. With a lever arm d = 50 m between column groups and four mega-columns per side, each column's axial force changes by ΔP = M_o/(d×4) = 9.28×10⁶/(50×4) ≈ 46,400 kN. If each column carries 250,000 kN of gravity, the windward columns lose only about 18.6% of their compression and never go into net tension; raising the outrigger share to 60% gives ΔP ≈ 69,600 kN (about 27.8%), still in compression, but outrigger and joint design forces rise in proportion and the added forces from long-term differential shortening must be checked as well. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual design.
history: 環球貿易廣場是西九龍九龍站上蓋發展「Union Square」的核心，2000 年 Kohn Pedersen Fox 贏得有限邀請競圖，Wong & Ouyang 為合作建築師，業主為新鴻基地產。結構概念由 Leslie E. Robertson 提出八根巨柱、核心筒與外伸臂的方案，Arup 在施工階段擔任結構工程並發展摩擦型壁樁基礎，該基礎形式在當時對香港相對較新。塔樓 2002 年動工、2010 年完工，頂部的麗思卡爾頓酒店於 2011 年 3 月開業，成為香港最高建築。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~The International Commerce Centre is the centrepiece of the Union Square development above Kowloon Station in West Kowloon. Kohn Pedersen Fox won a limited international competition in 2000, with Wong & Ouyang as associate architect and Sun Hung Kai Properties as developer. Leslie E. Robertson proposed the structural concept of eight mega-columns, a core and outriggers, and Arup served as execution structural engineer and developed the friction barrette foundations, a system then relatively new to Hong Kong. Construction began in 2002 and was completed in 2010, and the Ritz-Carlton hotel at the top opened in March 2011, making it Hong Kong's tallest building. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 高度 484 m，地上 108 層、地下 4 層，樓層編號至 118~Height 484 m, 108 floors above ground and 4 below, numbered up to 118
2002 年動工，2010 年完工，酒店 2011 年 3 月 29 日開業~Construction 2002 to 2010, with the hotel opening on 29 March 2011
八根巨柱與核心筒以 4 道外伸臂相連，最低 1 道為預力混凝土~Eight mega-columns linked to the core by 4 outrigger levels, the lowest 1 in prestressed concrete
岩盤深約 70 至 130 m，壁樁平均深約 70 m（約 230 ft）~Bedrock lies about 70 to 130 m below ground; barrettes average about 70 m (about 230 ft) deep
巨柱在底部外撇約 3°，上部三分之一主立面內傾 1°~Mega-columns splay out about 3° at the base and the upper third of the main façades leans in 1°
結構鋼材超過 30,000 公噸~More than 30,000 t of structural steel
標準層約 32,000 平方英尺，78 層以上減為約 29,000 平方英尺~Typical floors about 32,000 sq ft, reducing to about 29,000 sq ft above the 78th floor
CTBUH 資料庫列出電梯共 86 部~The CTBUH database lists 86 elevators
